(FAQ)

Questions

Which tools can you connect?

Most popular CRMs, calendars, form builders, payment, accounting and email tools. If a tool has an API or a Zapier/Make integration, we can usually connect it.

Do I need new software?

Usually not. We start with what you already pay for and only suggest a new tool when it clearly saves money or time.

What happens if an automation fails?

Every flow has alerts. If something breaks, we hear about it and fix it, and important messages fall back to a person.

How fast will I see results?

Lead follow-up and reminders usually go live in the first one to two weeks.
